_comment: This file is a unittest test suite for WhisperFeatureExtractor. It contains no callable production APIs or CLI entry points. All classes and functions are test fixtures and test methods only.
run_test_WhisperFeatureExtractionTest: run the WhisperFeatureExtractionTest unittest suite to validate WhisperFeatureExtractor feature extraction behavior
test_WhisperFeatureExtractor_save_and_lo: test that WhisperFeatureExtractor can be saved to disk and reloaded with identical mel filters and config
test_WhisperFeatureExtractor_call_paddin: test the WhisperFeatureExtractor call method with padding and truncation on batched and unbatched inputs
test_WhisperFeatureExtractor_dither: test that WhisperFeatureExtractor dithering adds small noise to input features without significantly altering them
test_WhisperFeatureExtractor_torch_numpy: test WhisperFeatureExtractor integration with both torch tensors and numpy arrays against expected output values
